gap: No result ChatGPT got states a measured runtime for the MOJAWA Run Plus. Headphones Addict (Peter Susic) measured 8 h 43 min of playback at 50% volume and a 0–100% charge in 50 minutes; in ChatGPT's answers the battery figures are only maker claims (8 h for the MOJAWA, about 5–6 h for the Jabees).
standout_why: I opened SoundMavericks (cited, 2026-10-26, Mark Folksman). It gives only maker or manual battery figures and says it measured nothing. Every battery figure ChatGPT showed (MOJAWA 8 h, Jabees ~5–6 h, FINIS 7 h, PSIER 8 h) is a maker claim with no named tester. WIRED and Verywell Fit refused the fetch, and the TechRadar roundup returned only its title, so I could not confirm those three lack a measured number. That is why this scores 2, not 3. Our own page already has '8 h 43 min measured' but does not name who measured it.
decides: It confirms the MOJAWA Run Plus as the pick: the only measured runtime among the under-$100 candidates beats its own 8 h claim (at 50% volume, not the 75% MOJAWA uses). The Jabees 7Seven has no measured runtime. New Atlas only says it 'appears to land close to the claim' of 5 h Bluetooth / 6 h MP3 and did not time it, so there is no measured figure to set against the MOJAWA's. The finding does not change the order of the picks. It lets the page attribute the battery figure to a named tester and add a measured 50-minute full charge.

findings.note: Updated 2025-10-18. Low confidence: the article gives the weight as 10.9 oz (Headphones Addict lists 29.7 g), says 11 headphones in the intro but lists 13, and gives 5 min of charge = 80 min of play where MOJAWA claims 1.5 h. Don't use it as the headline figure.

findings.source_title: New Atlas – Jabees 7Seven bone-conduction swimming headphones (Bronwyn Thompson)
